description: Compare the Zalo Official Account plans in force from 1 June 2026 (Cơ bản, Tiêu chuẩn, Tăng trưởng, Toàn diện) with prices including 10% VAT, staff accounts, Open API and its requests-per-minute limit, consultation messages outside the 48-hour window and features, and pick the smallest plan that meets your needs (needs_api, api_requests_per_minute, replies_outside_48h_per_month, staff, features, term_months 6 or 12), with the reason and the paid-reply overage. The Cơ bản price is not published by Zalo. Reference only. Examples: {}; {"needs_api":true,"staff":8}; {"replies_outside_48h_per_month":3000,"features":["chatbot"],"term_months":6}.

api_requests_per_minute.description: Peak OA API requests per minute (implies needs_api when above 0).

features.description: Required features: chat_basic, chat_advanced_labels_assign_notes, group_chat_gmf, voice_call_basic, voice_call_advanced, mobile_chat_tool, basic_automation, chat_menu, chatbot, extensions, articles_comments_campaign_tool, advanced_reports_activity_log_crm, search_in_zalo_share_qr, follow_invitations, custom_url_priority_features_priority_support.

needs_api.description: The OA needs the Open API (for integrations or sending template messages through the API). Default false.

replies_outside_48h_per_month.description: Consultation messages per month sent more than 48 hours after the user's last interaction (paid replies).

staff.description: Staff accounts that will work in the OA. Default 1.

term_months.description: Plan term: 12 (default) or 6 months (6 months only for Tăng trưởng and Toàn diện).

name: oa_plan_compare
title: Zalo OA plan comparison
